subject: an instruction file that coding agents read at the start of every session, such as AGENTS.md

criteria.question: Is the file a map rather than an encyclopedia?
criteria.pass: it points to where detail lives (files, commands, checks) and keeps each entry to a line or two
criteria.fail: it holds long explanations, procedures or reference material that the files it could point to should hold

criteria.question: Does each rule say why it exists, or name what enforces it?
criteria.pass: a reader can tell why each rule matters, or which check will fail when it's broken
criteria.fail: some rules are bare orders, with no reason and nothing named that enforces them

criteria.question: Are the rules free of contradictions?
criteria.pass: no two rules ask for opposite things
criteria.fail: two rules can't both be followed, or one undoes another
